name: Hiroo (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hiroo town emblem in white and yellow: a yellow stylised mountain and character within a white ornamental triangular frame.
history: Municipal flag of Hiroo, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1950.

features.role: Hiroo town emblem — a yellow stylised mountain and character within a white ornamental triangular frame
